The '''Sylvester graph''' is the unique [[Distance regular graph|distance-regular]] graph
with intersection array <math>\{5,4,2;1,1,4\}</math>.<ref>{{citation
  | last1 = Brouwer
  | first1 = A. E.
  | last2 = Cohen
  | first2 = A. M.
  | last3 = Neumaier
  | first3 = A.
  | title = Distance-regular graphs
  | publisher = Springer-Verlag
  | year = 1989
  | id = Theorem 13.1.2
}}</ref>
It is a subgraph of the [[Hoffman–Singleton graph]].
